prompt: Teddy trades lunch for a dinosaur book
title: Dinosaur Book
irony: Teddy trades his lunch to feed his mind with dinosaurs and sits too hungry to read until stingy Lou gives lunch back free.

beats.title: The street wakes
beats.summary: Teddy and Benny sit at Lou's Diner with steaming lunch trays and spot a shiny dinosaur book across the road.

beats.title: The setup
beats.summary: Teddy names each dinosaur correctly but refuses to taste lunch he has not read about first.

beats.title: The setup builds
beats.summary: Sterling twirls a shiny dinosaur book beside his food truck and offers to swap it for Teddy's lunch tray.

beats.title: The hook
beats.summary: Teddy swaps his tray for the book while the kids chant and Lou watches from the diner door.

beats.title: The problem
beats.summary: Teddy clutches the book with a growling tummy and corrects Benny's sandwich facts instead of eating.

beats.title: The problem builds
beats.summary: Teddy reads roaring dinosaur lunch facts to his own rumbling tummy while Benny offers half his sandwich.

beats.title: The hook again
beats.summary: The kids chant again as Teddy hugs the book and his tummy growls louder.

beats.title: The turn
beats.summary: Lou watches hungry Teddy from the counter and remembers quietly paying for Murphy's soup on rainy days.

beats.title: The turn deepens
beats.summary: Lou decides to place a warm free lunch before Teddy and leaves the dinosaur book in his hands.

beats.title: The hook, grown
beats.summary: Lou sings the changed line while Teddy shares dinosaur facts and eats the warm free lunch.

beats.title: Settle down
beats.summary: Back at the diner table with trays and book, Teddy reads aloud while sharing lunch with Benny.
